windows.development: decision days whose five targets fall on or before 2025-12-31 (#1255's first window). Every reading is taken from this window.
windows.2026: decision days whose five targets fall from 2026-01-02 to 2026-09-03 (the near-blind tier open since GO #151). Reported separately and decides nothing: tables 1, 3 and 5 only.

arms.reference_flag: sc_s3c at lead 1 and sc_s3c_ann at leads 2 to 5 (the two are cell for cell the same at lead 1, which the study checks): (s3c) and the announced flag
arms.net: sc_s3c_ann_net, (s3c-ann-net); at lead 1 it is #1273's (s3c-net), which the study checks
arms.also_read: sc_s3c, for the lead-1 and 2020 comparisons that #1316 states

unit: A diagnostic difference d is score(arm) - score(reference), so a positive mean d is a loss for the arm (the arm scores higher, worse); every table says which way it points. Scores are grid CRPS, upper-tail twCRPS and the Brier score of P(> +5 bp), as in #1288 (scripts/s3c_net_settlement_1273.py cell_table). Percentages are skill, 1 - mean(arm)/mean(reference), as on #1288's page.
intervals: the 90% interval of the stationary block bootstrap (mean block 10, 2000 replications, seed 1319, resampling in date order) over the days of the group, repo_model.metrics.stationary_bootstrap_interval. It is a diagnostic interval on mean d, not scoring protocol v1's studentized test; no row here is a verdict and a group of fewer than 20 days is listed and given no interval. A reading is taken from the interval excluding zero; otherwise undecided.
legs_of_the_net: gross: the offerings of the class that the decision instant had seen, summed (a class announced only in part is left out and counted, as net_settlement.net_for_day leaves it out); maturing: the largest announced maturing figure of the class; net: gross less maturing, as net_settlement.net_for_day gives it. All in USD 100 bn. A class partly announced at the decision is its own group and enters no regression.

1_lead_1_loss.what: Where the lead-1 loss of (s3c-ann-net) against (s3c) sits. At lead 1 nothing is announced early, so the whole difference is the net sizing of the two settlement terms against their flags.
1_lead_1_loss.cells: lead 1, one cell per decision day; grain: the decision day
groups: the target day type: a coupon settlement day, a bill settlement day with a cash management bill, a bill settlement day without one, neither settles

the net-to-gross class of the target day as announced at the decision: no settlement; net at or below zero on a settling leg; net above zero and below half of gross on every settling leg; net at or above half of gross on every settling leg; a class partly announced

the maturing share of gross on a settling day, in three classes fixed by the maturing share of gross over the settlement target days of the development window (an input, no outcome): lowest third, middle third, highest third
1_lead_1_loss.report: mean d with interval for each score; the group's days; the group's share of the total of d over all lead-1 cells (share of the loss)

2_gross_or_net.what: H-a. Whether settlement-day pressure scales with the gross amount, the net, or the maturing amount, tested on the settlement target days of the development window.
2_gross_or_net.cells: target days T on which a leg settles with its class fully announced at the decision of T - h; at lead 1 and at lead 3. The outcome is the residual r = y_T - q50 of the reference forecast at that lead ((s3c) at lead 1, (s3c-ann) at lead 3), in bp, where q50 is the forecast's median (the 0.5 level of the grid).
2_gross_or_net.regressions: per leg L (coupon, bill), on the target days where L settles: r = a + g * gross_L + m * maturing_L + o * other_leg_settles. Also the net-only form r = a + n * net_L + o * other_leg_settles. gross, maturing and net in USD 100 bn. Ordinary least squares; the interval of each coefficient and of g + m is the stationary block bootstrap (seed 1319, 2000 replications) over the target days in date order, refitting at every resample. If the net were the whole story the maturing amount would offset the gross one for one, m = -g, so g + m = 0; the reading is on g + m. The in-sample mean squared residual of the gross-and-maturing form, of the net-only form and of the gross-only form (m = 0) are reported with the interval of the net-only form minus the gross-and-maturing form.
2_gross_or_net.splits: pooled; by the scarcity state of the decision day (0 abundant, 1 to 2, 3 scarce; #1145's state, as read at the decision instant; a day with no state is its own group); a split of fewer than 20 target days or a leg with no variation in gross is listed and not fitted.
2_gross_or_net.reading_H_a: supported at a lead and leg when the interval of g + m lies above zero (the maturing amount offsets less than the gross amount adds, so netting understates the pressure) and the net-only form's mean squared residual is not below the gross-and-maturing form's by more than its interval; not supported when the interval of g + m contains zero and the net-only form's mean squared residual is below the gross-only form's with the interval of the difference above zero, or when the interval of g + m lies below zero; otherwise undecided. A lead and leg that disagree are reported as they are.

3_net_against_flag.what: Loss 3 and the second half of H-a: (s3c-ann-net) against (s3c-ann) at every lead, and where it loses.
3_net_against_flag.cells: each lead h = 1..5, one cell per decision day; grain: the decision day for the lead rows; the target day averaged over the five leads for the regime rows, as #1288 groups by regime
groups: by lead: pooled, and by regime of the target day (2018-19, 2020, 2021-23, 2024, 2025-26)

by realised event: the cells whose target spread exceeded +5 bp (the event of docs/decisions/pressure-probability.md, strict, whole basis points) and the others: the arm's mean predicted probability of the event, the reference's, the observed frequency, and the Brier difference summed over each of the two sets
by the target day type and by the net-to-gross class of table 1, at each lead (the class at lead h is read at the decision of T - h)
the days on which the flag is 1 and the announced net is at or below zero on every settling leg (the arm sees no drain, the flag sees a settlement)
3_net_against_flag.report: mean d with interval for each score; the group's cells; the share of the total of d

4_2020.what: H-b. Why every announced-settlement arm loses to (s3c) in 2020.
4_2020.cells: decision days with a target in the 2020 regime, as #1288's regime group (grain: the target day, the five leads averaged); leads 2 to 5 where a table says so
tables: 4a: the 2020 loss of (s3c-ann) and (s3c-ann-net) against (s3c), by month of the target day, and March to June against the rest of 2020; the share of the total 2020 loss that sits in March to June

4b: the settlement-term contribution against the realised spread, by regime: at leads 2 to 5, for each arm, the mean fitted shift in bp that the settlement terms add on the settlement target cells (the fitted effect of the refit the forecast used, in bp, times the term's value: the flag, or the net in USD 100 bn; the same construction as #1288's `effects`), the mean forecast error y_T - q50 on the settlement target cells less that on the cells with no settlement (the settlement-day bias: negative when the arm forecasts too high on settlement days), and the realised mean spread on settlement target days less that on the others. Interval by the decision-day bootstrap

4c: the 2020 loss of each arm against (s3c) at leads 2 to 5 by the scarcity state of the decision day (0, 1 to 2, 3) and by settlement size of the target day (the highest third of total gross over the settlement target days of the development window; other settlement days; no settlement), the cells and the share of the 2020 loss

4d: the 2020 cells whose target day has an auction with no stated release time ('For Immediate Release') in metadata/announcement_release_times_1301.json settling on it, a cash management bill or not: the loss in them, their share of the total 2020 loss, and the 2020 loss of each arm with them left out
4_2020.reading_H_b: supported when, on the 2020 settlement target cells, the settlement-day bias of the arm is below that of 2018-19 by an interval below zero (the settlement terms over-predict relative to the earlier years), and the 2020 loss on the highest third of settlement size with state 0 or 1 to 2 is a loss on the interval while the rest of 2020 is not; not supported when either fails with an interval that excludes it; otherwise undecided. The dating is ruled out as the cause when the 2020 loss with the immediate-release days left out stays a loss on the interval.

guards: every cell passes lockbox.require_unlocked through spread_mean_reversion_686.require_scored_days with the window's last day; the blind tier and every lockbox day are refused by the frames' own guards; no day after 2026-09-03 is read.
